# Fire Up Hibachi

> Premium hibachi catering serving Riverside & the Inland Empire, California

## About

Fire Up Hibachi is a professional hibachi and teppanyaki catering service with 14 years of cooking experience. We bring the authentic Japanese hibachi experience directly to your event, providing both exceptional cuisine and entertaining chef performances.

**Owner/Chef:** Hernan Loredo
**Phone:** (951) 376-6014
**Website:** https://fireuphibachi.com
**Location:** Riverside, California (serving the entire Inland Empire)

## Services

- **Corporate Events**: Team building, networking events, client appreciation dinners, product launches, holiday parties
- **Wedding Catering**: Wedding receptions, rehearsal dinners, anniversary celebrations
- **Private Parties**: Birthday parties, graduation celebrations, family reunions, backyard events
- **Teppanyaki Entertainment**: Live cooking performances with knife skills and chef entertainment

## Service Areas

We serve the following cities in California's Inland Empire:
- Riverside
- Corona
- Moreno Valley
- Temecula
- Rancho Cucamonga
- Ontario
- Fontana
- San Bernardino
- Murrieta
- Perris

## Menu Highlights

Our hibachi catering includes:
- Premium proteins (steak, chicken, shrimp, salmon)
- Fresh vegetables cooked teppanyaki-style
- Fried rice and noodles
- Signature sauces (yum yum sauce, ginger sauce, teriyaki)
- Customizable menus for dietary restrictions

## Why Choose Us

- 14 years of professional cooking experience
- 5.0 star rating from verified reviews
- 500+ events catered
- Full-service catering (setup to cleanup)
- Interactive chef entertainment
- Licensed and insured
- Premium quality ingredients only
